fraud.title: Fraud review
fraud.intro: A flagged payee's payouts stay held until two different people agree. One treasurer reviews and recommends; a second treasurer or an admin decides.
fraud.emptyHint: Flags raised by the payment scan, the payout run or a treasurer appear here.
fraud.loadFailed: Could not load the fraud flags.
fraud.kindHint.payer_velocity: One payer made many payments in a short time, which is typical of stolen cards being tested.
fraud.kindHint.payer_concentration: Most of this payee's income comes from a few payers or from brand-new accounts.
fraud.kindHint.new_payee: The payee's first payout ever is unusually large.
fraud.kindHint.manual: A treasurer held this payee's payouts by hand.
fraud.evidence.velocityPayments: Payments from one payer within {minutes} minutes
fraud.evidence.newPayerShare: Share from accounts younger than {days} days
fraud.heldPayouts: {count, plural, =0 {No payouts held right now} one {# payout held} other {# payouts held}}
fraud.releasedPayouts: This flag no longer holds payouts
fraud.confirmed.held: Payouts stay held until an admin releases this flag.
fraud.noteHint: Visible to treasurers only, never in the audit log. Do not paste personal data.
fraud.review.label: Review the flag on @{username}
fraud.review.title: Review the flag on @{username}
fraud.review.hint: Record what you recommend. A different person then decides; your review alone releases nothing.
fraud.review.next: A second person decides after your review.
fraud.review.ownPayouts: You cannot review a flag on your own payouts.
fraud.decide.label: Decide the flag on @{username}
fraud.decide.title: Decide the flag on @{username}
fraud.decide.hint: Clearing releases the payee's held payouts when no other flag holds them. Confirming keeps them held, also in later payout runs, until an admin releases the flag.
fraud.decide.secondPerson: Needs a second person: not the reviewer and not whoever raised the flag.
fraud.decide.youReviewed: You reviewed this flag, so a second treasurer or an admin must decide it.
fraud.decide.youRaised: You raised this flag, so a second treasurer or an admin must decide it.
fraud.decide.ownPayouts: You cannot decide a flag on your own payouts.
fraud.raise.title: Hold a payee's payouts
fraud.raise.hint: Raises a flag for review and holds the payee's unpaid payouts at once. Paid payouts are not affected.
